## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Jul 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Vaporizedretinas_, Jul 21, 2026, 1/5: "Cancelled my subscription after several years. The app just gets more buggy and less intuitive with each update. It just gets more and more frustrating to use (and that’s not even dealing with the incorrect directions and videos for the exercises). I just don’t want to deal with it anymore."
            2. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            3. _Bon Jarker_, Jul 21, 2026, 5/5: "I’ve seen ads touting another app compared to this. That app is just a clone of this and full of bugs."
